notes.title: BIG UPDATE: Dead Eye ability, breast animation, new enemies
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We are happy to finally introduce you to our new and most pleasing update.

The main feature we've added is Dead Eye ability. Now you can activate slowmotion to kill your enemies even more ruthless!

https://i.imgur.com/73ctq3c.gif

To activate Dead Eye you need to fill with your enemies’ blood grey skulls in the left bottom of the screen. One kill — one skull filled. After that you can hit "F" button to activate the ability.



Besides, we've added a couple of new enemy models. Plus, now they feature a Voice Acting.

https://i.imgur.com/LmaBALL.gif



On top of that, we've added animation to face and boobs.
https://i.imgur.com/hvnZdhL.gif



We've worked a bit on our weapons and decided to change grenade to dynamite. It’s more cool and now has a nice explosion sound effect. Plus, new blood effect.

https://i.imgur.com/OBSqal3.gif



And in addition to all of that, We've added some helpful pointing tips on loading screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36221742/48639029225154524499e82e770cab66a9324e7c.png



Cheers,
Konnichiwa Games
